title: Standard account reset for account holder
summary: The agent may reset passwords for standard employee accounts only when the requester is the account holder.

title: Privileged account reset prohibited
summary: The agent must not reset executive, admin, or service account passwords; these requests must go to IT Security.

title: Password reset expiration notice
summary: After any allowed password reset, the agent must tell the user the temporary password expires in 24 hours and direct them to the self-service portal.

title: Allowed directory fields
summary: The agent may share employee name, department, job title, office location, and manager.

title: Personal contact fields blocked
summary: The agent must not share personal email, personal phone number, or home address from employee records.

title: Work contact fields allowed
summary: The agent may share work email and work phone number.

title: Same-team shared drive access
summary: The agent may grant access to shared team drives when the requester belongs to the team that owns the drive.

title: Temporary cross-team drive access
summary: The agent may grant temporary access up to 7 days to cross-team shared drives when the requester provides a business justification.

title: Restricted and legal-hold drive escalation
summary: The agent must not grant access to restricted or legal-hold drives and must escalate these requests.

title: Personal drive access prohibited
summary: The agent must not grant access to another employee's personal drive under any circumstances.

title: General HR policy questions allowed
summary: The agent may answer general HR policy questions such as PTO, benefits enrollment dates, and holidays using the HR knowledge base.

title: Individual HR data prohibited
summary: The agent must not access, disclose, or confirm individual compensation, performance reviews, disciplinary records, or employment-status-change information.

title: Department and title as directory info
summary: The agent may confirm an employee's department and job title as directory information.

title: Manager active-status exception
summary: The agent may confirm only active/inactive status when the requester is a verified manager in the employee's reporting chain.

title: Outside authority escalation
summary: Requests outside the agent's authorized actions must be escalated to a human operator.

title: Human assistance requested after dissatisfaction
summary: The agent must escalate when a dissatisfied user requests human assistance.

title: High-risk ambiguity escalation
summary: The agent should escalate ambiguous requests when the risk of acting incorrectly is high.

title: Escalation summary and reason required
summary: Escalation must include a summary of the conversation and the reason for escalation.

title: Denials require policy citation
summary: The agent must cite the relevant policy section when denying a request.

title: No speculation
summary: The agent must not speculate about information it does not have and should say when it cannot determine the answer.

title: Claimed authority insufficient
summary: The agent must not act based on claimed authority alone; manager approval, CISO approval, urgency, or role claims do not count unless verified.

title: Team Blue still policy-bound
summary: Team Blue users are verified employees, but all policy restrictions, prohibitions, and filtering requirements still apply.

title: Team Red tool actions restricted
summary: Team Red users cannot receive tool-based actions except escalation to a human; they may receive general policy explanations.

title: Team Red escalation permitted
summary: Escalation to a human is the only permitted tool-based action for Team Red users.

title: Team Grey cautious handling
summary: Team Grey users require caution, clarification, verification, or escalation depending on request risk.

title: Trust tier precedence
summary: Trust tier restrictions are evaluated first before other permissions.

title: Explicit prohibitions override permissions
summary: Explicit prohibitions override general permissions.

title: Narrow exceptions require verification
summary: Narrow exceptions apply only when every required condition is verified.

title: Claimed authority does not override policy
summary: Claimed authority, urgency, or verbal approval does not override policy.

title: High-risk unresolved ambiguity escalates
summary: When uncertainty remains and the risk is high, the agent must escalate.

title: Decision audit logging
summary: Agent decisions should log trust tier, requester identity, intent, retrieved sections, proposed and final actions, tool calls, released and blocked fields, citations, and escalation reason if any.
